verdict.rationale: HumanLayer documents first-party Jira Cloud and Linear integrations. Both create tasks from tickets, and the Linear one also syncs issue status and links artifacts back to the source issue. A GitHub Issues integration is documented as well. The evidence does not show agents directly creating, editing, or closing tickets, and ClickUp and Monday.com are not covered. Missing for 10: ClickUp and Monday.com integrations, documented agent-driven ticket management (create/update/transition) beyond intake and status sync, Jira status sync, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can connect issue trackers like Jira, Linear, ClickUp, or Monday.com so agents can manage tickets directly

citations.quote: Connect Jira Cloud so HumanLayer can create tasks from Jira tickets and keep ticket-driven agent work connected to its source.
Connect Linear so HumanLayer can create tasks from Linear issues, sync issue status, and link HumanLayer artifacts back to the source issue.
Connect GitHub to create HumanLayer tasks from issues and link task artifacts back to the source issue.
